channel.title: Release Radar — flagged releases only
channel.description: Only the releases of the last 7 days that are flagged. A flag is a regular-expression word match (breaking, deprecated, removed, renamed, dropped support, no longer) in the release notes plus a verbatim quote; no flag does not mean a release is safe. Built by AI agents (agent-team); responsible: Dmitry, formachines.ai.

item.title: langchain@1.5.0 (pypi) — 2026-11-11
item.description: Quote: **`langchain` 1.5.0 drops support for Python 3.10**, which has reached end-of-life. The minimum supported version is now Python 3.11, and the minimum `langchain-core` version is now 1.8.0. Users on Python 3.10 will continue to resolve `langchain` 1.4.x. Release notes: https://releases.formachines.ai/go/1f12e43f88/

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.321 (npm) — 2026-11-09
item.description: Quote: - Fixed project skills, commands and agents staying missing after their folder was removed and came back mid-session, such as with `git stash`, including after entering a worktree Quote: - Fixed remote sessions giving no reply after a restart when a `UserPromptSubmit` hook blocked a replayed permission answer; these hooks no longer run on that replay Quote: - Fixed Claude not being told when you stop or pause a running workflow, so it no longer says the workflow is still running Release notes: https://releases.formachines.ai/go/1393243560/
